chunks.text: Topic: Relationships Among Living Things Source: SAINS T6 SJKT.pdf Generated by AI-EZAM source converter. NEEDS_REVIEW: Review Tamil terms for local classroom preference. Key terms: - Living things = உயிரினங்கள் | Things that can grow, need food or water, and reproduce. - Relationship = தொடர்பு | How living things affect or depend on each other. - Interaction = இடையினைவு | Action between living things. - Competition = போட்டி | When living things need the same limited resource. - Predator = வேட்டையாடி | An animal that hunts another animal for food. - Prey = இரை | An animal that is hunted for food. - Habitat = வாழிடம் | The place where a living thing lives. - Food chain = உணவுச் சங்கிலி | A chain showing how living things get food energy. Tamil wording guidance: - Prefer simple Tamil suitable for SJKT Year 6 students. - Keep English science terms only when commonly used in class.

NEEDS_REVIEW: Review misconception guidance against source diagrams and examples. Common misconceptions and correction guidance: - Wrong idea: only animals interact. Correction: plants also interact and compete for resources. - Wrong idea: competition means fighting only. Correction: it means living things need the same limited resource. - Wrong idea: predator and prey are friends. Correction: predator hunts prey for food. - Wrong idea: non-living things have relationships like living things. Correction: this topic focuses on living things.

Generated learning support below is based on the expected Year 6 Science topic scope and should be reviewed against the source. Teaching notes: - Living things interact with one another to get food, water, shelter, space, and protection. - Competition happens when living things need the same limited resources. - Predator-prey relationships happen when one animal hunts another animal for food. - Some relationships help both living things, while some help one living thing and may harm another. - Plants and animals depend on each other in habitats and food chains. - Generated learning support
